explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/243. Rationality of Σ 1/a_n is neatly encoded as summability in ℚ, which for positive terms means convergence to a rational limit. Together with strict monotonicity and a_n/a_{n-1}² → 1, the conclusion is that a_n = a_{n-1}² - a_{n-1} + 1 eventually. Allowing a₀ = 0 only adds a junk 1/0 = 0 term and is harmless. It is correctly marked open.
